name: Erico and Pete
source:
Erico and Pete is a visual novel about the adventures of a bunch of cartoonish characters like the titular Erico and Pete, Monika, Kate, Supercavemanwomanboygirl, de and others!

[Edited from [url=https://nisson.itch.io/erico-and-pete]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《埃里科和皮特》是一部视觉小说，讲述了一群卡通人物的冒险故事，比如名义上的埃里科和皮特、莫妮卡、凯特、超级穴居人、女人、男孩女孩、德等等！

[编辑自[url=https://nisson.itch.io/erico-and-pete]Itch.io[/url]]
